“The fragments are seated. Complete the severance.”
The operative tears out the last ward-pin. Three lights crack; the floor shudders. The masked pair escape through a collapsing side shaft.
“Edda, sweetheart. Come down. I have been waiting.”
“Abandon your posts. Open the northern road.” The real captain is nowhere near the chamber.
“You know that voice. Surely you can trust it.” Edda refuses the false instruction and leads the survivors away.
